issue.title: Make the LSP store identity-lock wait test contend deterministically
issue.description: lsp-store-lock-flake: resolve bob-cli-dv in sase tests/test_sase_core_wheel_cache_tool.py::test_lsp_store_rechecks_after_waiting_for_identity_lock. The node failed under parallel scoped load of SASE check 5d1634e22bc172fe358db97b9279961f (AssertionError: Waiting for the shared build lock in empty stderr) and passed 3/3 isolated reruns on the same tree (d79366e7627ad5290e34d797cb5c6a7a, f02021819c78b654a26d3739e330ddeb, 6d94f3e4d28d96bbaf830bde9189b048). Root cause: FAKE_CARGO_DELAY=0.3 plus a 5s marker poll lets the first fake cargo finish before the second store contends. Hold the first process in cargo until the second is observed, or otherwise make the lock wait deterministic. Do not suppress the node. Verify with focused serial and parallel reruns plus sase tool run check.
